🎉 Student Organization Gala

A Night to Remember – Celebrate, Connect, and Shine

Join us for the Student Organization Gala, our biggest event of the year, where the student community comes together for an unforgettable evening of elegance, celebration, and good vibes.

👗 Dress Code: Formal / Gala attire

🎟 Tickets: Available now — limited spots!

What to expect:

  • A red carpet welcome
  • Live music and dance floor
  • Drinks, dinner, and dessert
  • Award ceremony and speeches
  • Photo booth, surprises, and more!

Whether you're here to party, make memories, or just enjoy a magical night out — this is your moment. Bring your friends, your best outfit, and your party spirit.

This isn’t just a party. It’s the night of the year.

👉 Reserve your ticket now and be part of something legendary.

Student Welcome Party

Your new semester starts right here!

Get ready for the wildest, friendliest, most unforgettable night of the semester — the Student Welcome Party is BACK and bigger than ever! 💃🕺 Whether you’re brand new on campus or a returning legend, this is your chance to meet amazing people, make instant memories, and kick off the semester with a bang. 💥

What to expect:

  • 🎧 A live DJ spinning bangers all night
  • 🍹 Signature welcome drinks + chill cocktail bar
  • 🍕 Free snacks to keep you fueled
  • 📸 Photo booth with props for those iconic shots
  • 🫶 Icebreaker games to meet your future besties
  • 🎁 Surprise giveaways (yes, actual cool stuff)
  • 🪩 A dance floor that never quits

Come dressed to impress or just as you are — there’s no pressure, only vibes. This is your space to connect, unwind, and celebrate the start of something amazing.

✨ Whether you're shy, social, or somewhere in between, we promise: You belong here. You’ll laugh here. You’ll party here.

Let this be your first big memory of the semester — one you’ll never forget.

🔥 Bring your energy. Bring your friends. Let’s light up the night together! 🔥

Travel the world without leaving campus!

Join us for an evening celebrating the diversity of our student community through food, music, traditions and stories from around the world.

Students will have the opportunity to share a dish, introduce their culture or simply come and discover something new.

What to expect:

  • International food tasting
  • Music from around the world
  • Cultural discoveries and activities
  • Fun challenges and games
  • A great opportunity to meet international students

📍 Location: Louvain-la-Neuve

⏰ Time: 7:00 PM

Bring a dish from your country, invite your friends and get ready for a night full of flavours and discoveries!
The Student Challenge – The Ultimate Team Competition

Think you have what it takes to be the ultimate student team?

Get ready for an evening of challenges, teamwork and friendly competition! Teams will compete in a series of fun and unexpected challenges designed to test creativity, knowledge, communication and team spirit.

No special skills are required — just bring your energy and your competitive side!

Challenges may include:

  • General knowledge quizzes
  • Creative challenges
  • Team-building games
  • Speed challenges
  • Surprise challenges

🏆 Prizes: Surprise...

📍 Location: Louvain-la-Neuve

⏰ Time: 4:00 PM

Form your team, choose your strategy and get ready to compete for the title!

Are you ready to take on the challenge?
